        run_id = run_id_match.group(1)
    
        trigger_secret_key = os.environ.get("TRIGGER_SECRET_KEY")
    
        # Poll for completion
        completed = False
        for _ in range(24): # 2 minutes total (24 * 5s)

              text=True
            )
